content.short: BloxBean builds open-source SDKs and developer tooling for teams building on Cardano and other blockchain networks.
content.description: BloxBean is an open-source developer tooling project focused on SDKs, frameworks, and implementation support for blockchain builders. Its work is aimed at helping teams solve common development challenges, integrate blockchain functionality more easily, and accelerate application development with reusable tooling. In the Cardano ecosystem, BloxBean fits best as a developer-focused toolkit for engineers who need practical infrastructure and software components rather than end-user products.
